week_1.days_1_3: Engagement farming — like/comment on Tier A prospects' recent posts
week_1.days_4_5: Send connection requests to all Tier A (5 requests) + top Tier B (10 requests) = 15 total
week_1.daily_budget: 3-5 connection requests per day, 10-15 engagements per day

week_2.days_1_3: Send remaining Tier B connections (3) + start Tier C (7) = 10 total
week_2.days_4_5: Follow up with anyone who accepted — warm conversation, point to website
week_2.daily_budget: 3-5 connection requests per day, follow-up messages to accepted connections

week_3.focus: Conversion — warm conversations to 15-min discovery calls
week_3.actions: Message accepted connections with value-first conversation. If they engage, propose 15-min call. Do NOT send booking links cold.

funnel.step_1_connect: Connection note links to https://gbautomation.xyz ONLY. No call ask. No booking link.
funnel.step_2_warmup: After they accept, send a warm follow-up message. Ask about their work, share a relevant insight. Point them to the website if they show interest. NO call ask yet.
funnel.step_3_discovery: Once they reply and engage in conversation, propose a casual 15-min discovery call. Keep it low-pressure.
funnel.step_4_intake: After the 15-min call, if qualified, book the 60-min consulting intake session.
